bundle.collection_evidence: The root package script test:app is exactly vitest, and the root test script only forwards to test:app. vitest.config.mts uses the default test discovery and has no wrapper that replaces positional arguments. The proposed command names the generated test file explicitly, so Vitest collects that file directly. No build step is required for this TypeScript test under Vitest.
bundle.functional_oracle_evidence: The test uses the existing rendered Excalidraw harness and Pointer helper, samples public domain geometry through global endpoint coordinates, and checks binding IDs plus reciprocal bound-element records. It does not use snapshots, source tokens, private patch text, arbitrary coordinate deltas, network calls, fixed ports, or new dependencies.
bundle.equivalent_implementation_check: An independently implemented fix that prevents rebinding or geometry updates from moving the untouched bound endpoint during the drag will keep every sampled start point within the numeric tolerance and will preserve the final bindings, so it passes.
bundle.incomplete_implementation_check: A solution that only changes final binding IDs, only fixes the final pointer-up state, or still recomputes the already-bound endpoint during any pointer move will fail one of the intermediate or final numeric stability assertions. A solution that drops reciprocal binding bookkeeping will fail the domain-semantic assertions.
